items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson was a full participant in Wednesday practice for the first time since his ankle injury, after missing three games.
items.why: First full practice since Week 4 ankle injury
items.implication: Trending toward return vs Bills; unlocks offense
items.opportunity: Boost to Zay Flowers efficiency and Ravens pass game

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love returns to practice per Wednesday injury report.
items.implication: Potential role increase in Cardinals backfield

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice limited in Wednesday practice, first participation since Week 4 hamstring.
items.implication: Availability vs Broncos uncertain; monitor rest of week
items.opportunity: Targets if active; Worthy/others reverse if out

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley DNP Wednesday walkthrough after limited snaps Week 7 (back); hamstring felt great post-game.
items.implication: Monitor for Commanders; Pierce to IR opens depth

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant at Wednesday practice.
items.why: Shoulder injury; coach notes rest possible
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; expected available vs Vikings

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participant Wednesday after injury in Week 7. Coach Campbell indicated likely fine for Sunday.
items.why: Ankle from Packers game; maintenance expected
items.implication: Availability not in jeopardy for Vikings matchup

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest. Expected available if practices later.
Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle DNP Wednesday after aggravating chest injury; status TBD based on practice.
items.opportunity: Courtland Sutton/others volume boost if out

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Lamar + Doyle unlock.
Prefer sell Chris Olave over Jordyn Tyson; rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer moving proven but sell high on unproven? Wait: sell Olave preferred

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could have big day vs Vikings defense pressuring Goff.
Jadarian Price is back, but can you put him right back into fantasy lineup?
Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9+ actual fantasy points over opportunity implied despite Kubiak loss, coverage shading, and limited supporting threats.
Lions full-PPR PPG: Gibbs RB1 (clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4, LaPorta TE6, Goff QB2, Jameson Williams WR24. No surprise given talent/schedule.
items.implication: Start all core Lions skill with confidence ROS
items.opportunity: High snap/target shares in productive offense
